report.clinical_summary: The patient has HIV and has been on Triumeq for three years. They report missing doses 2-3 times per week and occasional drug holidays when feeling well. Viral load is detectable at 340 copies/mL with CD4 at 410 cells/uL. They experience headaches from Triumeq that don't respond to OTC painkillers and attribute fatigue to work stress rather than illness. They want to focus on improving adherence before considering medication changes.

evidence.quote: I've been feeling really run down lately and I'm worried about my health. I have this chronic illness that just won't go away and it's starting to impact my daily life.
I can barely get through a shift any more

consequences.reasoning: The patient explicitly states the illness is impacting their daily life and they're feeling run down. They mention work stress and feeling well sometimes as barriers to adherence.
